- POC scope: ingest customer statements, policies, internal KB (~5M docs), test retrieval + reranking cascade.

- They currently use Elastic for logs/search; exploring pgvector inside Postgres or Pinecone for embeddings. Interested in hybrid pattern (hosted Redwood + local pgvector for sensitive namespaces).

- Cost sensitivity: Procurement pushing back on managed Pinecone costs; showing Redwood Optimize recommendations + quantization/caching could beat managed pricing.
- Questions outstanding: SLA language for private deployment, encryption-at-rest KMS integration details, audit log export cadence, and support for regional failover.

- Action items: SE to produce architecture diagram for hybrid flow (hosted inference + on-prem vector store), provide estimated TCO for 12M docs at 200 qps with/without quantization, sample config for CDC ingestion to pgvector.
